About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

title: E tech lead
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Atuamos em áreas essenciais como saúde, educação e justiça, sempre com o propósito de transformar serviços públicos por meio da tecnologia. Procuramos profissionais que entendam a importância do sucesso dos nossos clientes públicos, tenham compromisso com a geração de valor e saibam atuar em contextos desafiadores e estratégicos. Se você quer fazer parte de uma operação em plena expansão e contribuir com uma equipe estruturada e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.
  • Equipe de alto nível: Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: Valorizamos diversidade, bem-estar e crescimento profissional.

Benefícios e bem-estar

A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);

  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;

  • Dataform ou dbt;

O que a gente oferece

Diversidade e inclusão

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.

  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.

Consultor Comercial

Se você é um profissional motivado, orientado para resultados e apaixonado por tecnologia e contabilidade, essa posição oferece uma oportunidade única de crescimento profissional e impacto no mercado contábil, mesmo no ambiente de trabalho remoto. Descrição da função

O Consultor Comercial do Nibo é responsável por vender uma plataforma SaaS abrangente, que oferece soluções inerentes à rotina financeira, contábil e fiscal de escritórios contábeis e seus clientes.   • Prospectar e desenvolver relacionamentos com contadores e escritórios contábeis, identificando oportunidades de negócios e estabelecendo parcerias duradouras, utilizando principalmente meios de comunicação remotos, como e-mails, chamadas telefônicas e videoconferências.

description:
Overview

Backend Software Engineer (Node, Python, Ruby on Rails or Go!)

About the Role: As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovering, planning and developing, ending with testing and deploying. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility, and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, highly involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc), but also participating in the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress), our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among many other systems and products. You can work remotely or in a flexible regime, if you are in Curitiba, Brazil. Keep in mind that our teams work in the PST time zone, and your hours should be at least partially compatible with it.

Responsibilities

  • Develop internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer facing systems used by thousands of clients.
  • Collaborate with the Technology Director and BWZ Labs Team to support the Web Platform.
  • Research and learn new technologies and solutions, proposing implementations to fit product needs to improve performance and scale.

Who You Are

  • You are a software engineer with meaningful experience building web applications.
  • You are good at prioritizing your own work.
  • You are curious about how things are done and how they work.
  • You communicate deliveries and demands effectively with teammates and stakeholders.
  • You automate repetitive tasks and enjoy testing new things.

How Your Success Will Be Measured

  • Focus on effectiveness rather than effort; accountability for results, not hours worked.
  • Part of a collaborative team where teamwork is a key factor.

Your Skill Set Includes

  • Curiosity to understand how things work and openness to learning new technologies.
  • Great time-management and prioritization skills.
  • Openness to learn and use new programming languages.
  • Ability to read/write documentation for others and good English communication.

Required Experience

  • Meaningful experience building web applications using languages like PHP, Python, Ruby, GoLang, or similar.
  • Track record of contributing to end-to-end system development (UI, server-side logic, infrastructure).
  • Experience with system design of web applications.
  • Experience with JavaScript technologies such as React, Node.js, Next.js, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of databases and cloud infrastructure.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with AWS-based architecture.
  • Experience with Cloudflare platform.
  • Experience working with CMS (WordPress or similar).
  • Experience using AI IDEs and building LLM-based applications/workflows.
  • Experience with MVC frameworks and API development.
  • Experience writing tests and building deployment pipelines.

About Us

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work. Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally. We started in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by CEO Ben Aston. We’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 14 online publications. We have a startup-like, impact-driven environment with the creativity of an agency and the diversity of a global company. We’ve ranked in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Company list and received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication. We are listed as a Top Employer in Canada and BC. Our mission is to create a playbook for the future of work and empower communities to shape it. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Black and White Zebra is an equal opportunity employer and considers all candidates for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, marital status, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected category. We celebrate all backgrounds and attributes that contribute to an impactful and adaptable team.

Overview

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

noisaac, vivemos desafios grandiosos e instigantes, construindo um produto totalmente do zero. Nosso ponto de partida é sempre a investigação profunda dos reais problemas de escolas e responsáveis, para então idealizar e colocar em prática soluções simples, escaláveis e de alto impacto.

  • Revisar e otimizar fluxos de trabalho para aumentar a produtividade da equipe;
  • Garantir alinhamento contínuo com Product Managers (PMs), Designers e outras áreas de interface;
  • Planejar e gerenciar a alocação de recursos do time, equilibrando carga de trabalho e competências individuais.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia em liderança técnica de equipes de engenharia de software.

description:
Se você gosta de trabalhar com o público, tem boa comunicação, é organizado (a), tem o sentimento de dono e responsabilidade essa vaga é para você.

O Promotor de Merchandising é na linha de frente com os nossos clientes representando a Coty e fazendo com que os nossos produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para os nossos consumidores.

Responsabilidades

  • Reposição de mercadoria
  • Organização do layout
  • Conquista e montagem de pontos extras
  • Manuseio de ferramentas de controle via celular
  • Facilidade com aplicativos via celular
  • Habilidade com trabalho em equipe e negociação

  • Vaga para todos os estados do Brasil

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeição
  • 40% de desconto nos produtos Coty

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

About This Opportunity

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you’ll support teams across both Waterfall and Agile teams by delivering robust automated testing solutions. You’ll help define and maintain quality strategies, validation methods, and best practices across development, testing, UAT, and production environments to ensure consistent and reliable software delivery.

CLT and fully remote position. Must reside in Brazil. Benefits include:

  • Meal and restaurant vouchers
  • Fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses
  • Company-issued device (hardware and software)
  • Annual bonuses

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java, Python, or tool-specific languages
  • Automate regression, integration, and functional test cases following best practices
  • Balance manual vs. automated testing efforts to optimize coverage
  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions to improve product quality
  • Collaborate across Dev, QA, and product teams in a multi-tiered environment
  • Estimate testing efforts and timelines for sprint and project deliverables
  • Coordinate with third-party teams to ensure quality and timely delivery
  • Write and maintain QA documentation and standards
  • Optimize SQL queries and analyze automation script issues
  • Report defects with clear documentation and track quality risks
  • Support production implementations during off-hours maintenance windows
  • Monitor results against technical specs and distribute findings to stakeholders

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in test automation using Python and Java
  • Hands-on with automation testing tools: Postman, Robot, SoapUI, RestAssured, Playwright, DevTest (LISA), Locust
  • Strong background in white-box and black-box testing in multi-tiered environments
  • Experience with test frameworks like JUnit
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools: GitHub, Jenkins, ArgoCD
  • Basic understanding of Kubernetes and containerized apps (preferred)
  • Proven ability to define and maintain QA strategies, policies, and documentation
  • Proficient in IDEs like Eclipse and IntelliJ

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. Sophos sells all these solutions through reseller partners, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) worldwide, defending more than 600,000 organizations worldwide from phishing, ransomware, data theft, other everyday and state-sponsored cybercrimes. The solutions are powered by historical and real-time threat intelligence from Sophos X-Ops and the newly added Counter Threat Unit (CTU). Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at

The Channel Account Executive (CAE) is accountable for managing strategic Sophos partners.   • Drive high renewal rates by ensuring partners focus on their renewals and build an engagement plan to align Sophos and Partner teams, identify new business, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Ensure the Sophos Sales Centre of Excellence is proactively engaged to manage processes to progress and close of sub-100 user opportunities.
  • Motivate, educate, and ensure Partner sales and technical staff are go-to-market ready, provide access to certification and training materials and develop an enablement plan.

What You Will Bring

  • 3-5 years of channel sales and territory management in networking or security sectors
  • Experience building successful business and marketing plans
  • Understanding of the technology channel eco-system and the business model of different types of channel partners (VAR/MSP etc.)

  • Solid technical acumen able to explain the benefits of different technologies, strong cybersecurity knowledge an advantage
  • Experience of translating market trends and customer issues and needs into business opportunities for partners
  • Ability to thrive in a team selling environment, winning together outlook with the ability to build relationships and influence via email, telephone, and in person
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks at once

Ready to Join Us?

At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don\'t check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don\'t let a checklist hold you back –we encourage you to apply.

Our Commitment To You

All applicants will be treated in a fair and equal manner and in accordance with the law regardless of gender, sex, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion or belief, color, age, military veteran status, disability, pregnancy, maternity or sexual orientation. Summary

The Contract Specialist will provide acquisition support services to the Federal Bureau of Prisons. Each Contract Specialist shall have full authority to act for the contractor on all acquisition matters related to the daily operations of this resulting contract.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions

  • Work independently with little oversight by the Government.
  • Provide advice and recommendations for all elements in acquisition plans, including approaches, options, strategies, risks, contracting methods, competition, sources, cost, milestone schedules, etc.
  • Research existing Government-wide contracts for available products and services. Evaluate different approaches to and sources for OS services support. Research available suppliers and compare the services and costs of obtaining support from different providers.
  • Assist in the preparation of Independent Government Cost Estimates. Research analysis may include, but is not limited to, past purchases of the products or services, the current market value of the products or services, and other agency purchases of similar products or services.
  • Conduct market research to identify potential sources and contract vehicles. Potential sources should include socio-economic program participants (i.e. small businesses, small and disadvantaged businesses, HUB Zone businesses). Potential vehicles should include GSA vendors, Government-wide Agency contracts, and other agency contracts.
  • Conduct market surveys and prepare written documentation of market research.
  • Support the preparation of any and all of the following OA approved acquisition package documents.
  • Responsible for coordination/communication with program office personnel (SME's and COR's) during all phases of the initial acquisition processes and to coordinate/communicate during all phases of the initial acquisition with assigned Office of Acquisition Contracting Specialists (CS) and Contracting Officers (CO).
  • Support the creation of solicitations and amendments contract writing system. Ensure documents are uploaded into electronic filing system, eFile.
  • Support and provide professional opinion and business advice regarding selection of procurement methods and contract type.
  • Support negotiations, including the documentation of negotiation objectives and negotiation outcomes via the creation of Award Determination Memorandums.
  • Support the creation of award documents, modifications, and supporting documentation.
  • Support the Contracting Officer via responding to data calls, providing status updates, participating in meetings and conference calls with customers, and providing general administrative support directly related to acquisition functions/matters.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge

  • Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to perform full range of contract actions including solicitations, contract awards, modifications, negotiations, incorporation of changes, exercise of options, price analysis, and resolution of contract issues.
  • Possesses demonstrated knowledge of the Procurement Administrative Lead Time (PALT)Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to support proposal evaluations including price/cost analysis or technical proposal analysis in the Federal sector.
  • Possesses a clear understanding of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)
  • Possesses demonstrated negotiation and interpersonal skills.
  • Possesses demonstrated experience utilizing contracting writing systems.
  • Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to perform contract administration support services, including assistance with reviewing contractor performance, developing contract modifications, and investigating reports of contract discrepancies: contract closeout.
  • Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to perform document creation in support of the above actions, including Determination and Findings, Market Research Reports, Pre and Post Negotiation Memorandum/Award
  • Memorandum, Acquisition Plans, Sole Source Justifications, and other documents common to the acquisition process
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited educational institution and a minimum of five (5) to eight (8) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients. Or at least 24 semester hours in any combination of the following fields: accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, purchasing, economics or management.
  • MUST have previous Bureau of Prisons (BOP) experience.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients.
  • Experienced, skilled, and knowledgeable in all aspects of Federal Government acquisition (i.e. requirements development, budgeting and acquisition planning, market research, development of independent cost estimates.)
  • Must be able to obtain/maintain a Public Trust level clearance.
  • Must have the ability to pass a drug test if requested.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Experience in contract writing system Unified Financial Management (UFMS) preferred.
  • Active Secret clearance preferred.
  • 2 to 4 years of experience supporting Federal Customers (Department of Justice, DOJ highly preferred).

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $90,000 to $130,000 per year.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you\'ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

  • Ferramentas de automação (Cloud Build, Cloud Logging/Monitoring) para CI/CD e observabilidade.
  • Proficiência em SQL para análise e modelagem de dados.
  • Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.

  • Implementação de pipelines de dados/ML em Airflow ou Composer.
  • Participação em competições de ciência de dados ou publicações técnicas.
  • Noções de IA generativa multimodal (texto + imagem ou visão computacional).

About Grupo QuintoAndar: We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year. Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit:

Location & Remote Work
Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process Stages
The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application
  • Interview with Recruiter
  • Tech Screening
  • Technical Interview with Data Products Team
  • Offer

About the Area
In our Data Science team, you'll have the chance to work as a part of our product squads delivering features that enrich our product and a first class experience that we are known for. You'll work alongside brilliant minds, with different skills: Product Managers, Designers, UX Writers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers, etc. Be prepared for the job of your life - hard challenges, high expectations, intelligent life at work, meaningful conversations, outstanding productivity.

Some of the specific problems we work on in the Data Science team include search and recommendation systems; customer experience enhancement using ML such as automatic routing of tickets; pricing, liquidity and credit models; building a platform that enables us to develop and deploy all those solutions.

Note: This is a senior position. We expect you to have at least 3+ years of experience applying data science and creating machine learning models. If you have the skills, but are starting your journey in Data Science, please apply to the Data Scientist job instead.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop and deploy machine learning systems to production. The main use cases are related to chatbots and search.
  • Design and execute experiments.
  • Analyze a wide variety of data (structured and unstructured, observational and experimental) to improve current models or create new ones
  • Apply the scientific method to develop LLM-powered applications, including testing different prompts, exploring and understanding LLM capabilities, evaluating agents and prompts, assessing AI application guardrails, and building PoCs to validate the feasibility of generative AI for product features.
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions regarding the whole Data Science chapter (Guilds, Design Reviews, Demos, etc.)

What we are looking for:

  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through Data Science
  • Expert knowledge of machine learning concepts: regression and classification, clustering, neural networks, feature selection, cross-validation, curse of dimensionality, bias-variance tradeoff, model explainability, etc.
  • Good understanding of the engineering challenges to deploy machine learning systems to production
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Some knowledge or experience with Deep Learning
  • Experience with technical advice for other data scientists (technical leadership)
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills. We're looking for someone who loves Data Science & Machine Learning and is willing to share his/her knowledge with the other members of the Data Science Chapter
  • Good English skills (verbal and written) is mandatory

You’ll stand out if you:

  • Have a MSc. (or Undergrad + intense experience) in machine learning, data science, information retrieval, ranking systems, recommender systems, natural language processing or other relevant fields
  • Have experience with applied generative AI: AI agents, prompt engineering, LLMs finetuning (lora, qlora, peft), LLM routing, LLM monitoring, LLM guardrails
  • Have experience working at fast-growing startups

Important

  • Our hiring process starts with the application. If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.
  • All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

We’re looking for a results-driven and experienced Ecommerce Growth Manager to join our team.

As an Ecommerce Growth Manager at Common Thread Collective (CTC), you will be instrumental in driving client success through strategic media buying, precision optimization, and data-driven forecasting. You will lead the development of accurate, insight-driven forecasts, ensuring that every strategy is executed seamlessly to transform projections into tangible, scalable growth for our clients. This ongoing engagement builds trust, strengthens client relationships, and positions CTC as a strategic leader in performance marketing.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As an Ecommerce Growth Manager, you set a high standard, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and a results-focused approach.

You thrive on challenges, take ownership of outcomes, and are committed to building, optimizing, and scaling high-performance marketing strategies. We embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take full responsibility, drive excellence, and always deliver results.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren’t for everyone. They’re challenging. We’re looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.

  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast

  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.

  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

CONTRIBUTING BACK

DOMAIN

Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as an Ecommerce Growth Manager, supporting your journey every step of the way.

In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.

title: Sr. Data Science Analyst
description:
Overview

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market. Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike. We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible. If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Data Scientist on the Product team, you will be responsible for:

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models to quantify the risk level of transactions and credit operations, and optimize user onboarding and reduce losses.
  • Design and conduct complex data analyses on large volumes of transactional, user behavior, and demographic data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for model enhancement.
  • Optimize and maintain existing credit models, ensuring their stability, accuracy, and business impact through continuous monitoring and refinement.
  • Lead the design and execution of A/B tests and other experiments related to credit decision strategies, translating results into actionable business recommendations.
  • Build and optimize robust and scalable data pipelines for model training, inference, and performance monitoring.
  • Contribute to the adoption of best practices in data science, including model documentation, version control (Git), and code quality.

Requirements

  • Experience in data science, with a proven track record of independently developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • Programming and Tools: Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark. Experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn. Familiarity with platforms like Databricks, AWS, and Azure. Experience with Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Analytical Modeling & Machine Learning: Strong experience in building and implementing machine learning models. Solid knowledge of classification, regression, and clustering algorithms, as well as feature engineering and model selection techniques. Experience with model explanation techniques.

Job title and details


Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)


Location: Remote


Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)



Role overview


About The Role We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.



Key Responsibilities



  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).

  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).



Required Qualifications



  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.

  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Overview

Join to apply for the Chemistry Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. We are looking for smart, curious subject matter experts. As a Chemistry SME, you will guide AI models to understand complex chemistry concepts, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and contextual understanding in the domain.

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to train, refine, and evaluate Large Language Models with a focus on Chemistry content.

  • Master\'s or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific field.

  • Experience working with data annotation, content development, or training AI models is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for accuracy and scientific precision.
  • Technical Skills (Preferred): Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs); Experience using annotation tools or content management platforms; Basic knowledge of Python or data handling tools (preferred but not mandatory); Understanding of data quality control processes.

Assessment

The English language assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. This person will drive data science initiatives, provide technical guidance when needed, and leverage data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of data science methodologies, strong statistical expertise, and proven experience delivering impactful data solutions in a dynamic environment. This is a 1-year contract with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities

  • Use data analysis, visualization, and modeling tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Python, Pandas) to drive data-driven business strategies, with a focus on cost prediction for a two-sided marketplace.
  • Design and execute data science projects, including hypothesis development, statistical analysis, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) to answer key business questions and validate assumptions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and ensure alignment with Xometry’s objectives.
  • Analyze existing algorithms for accuracy and performance, provide recommendations for optimization, and update production code as necessary.
  • Query and extract data from databases (e.g., Snowflake, MongoDB) to support analysis and model development.
  • Implement robust data science methodologies, emphasizing best practices in code reproducibility, version control, and model deployment.
  • Continuously iterate and improve solutions within a fast-paced, agile environment, addressing challenges with innovative, data-driven approaches.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and continuous learning, encouraging knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree (M.S. or PhD) in applied math, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science
  • Strong expertise in SQL and Python (numpy, scipy, pandas, and scikit-learn preferred) and experience with API integrations using Python.
  • Proficient in applied statistics, including knowledge of probability distributions, confidence intervals, statistical tests (e.g., t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square), and power analysis.
  • Experience with pricing algorithms and technology-driven product development.
  • Knowledge of scientific software principles, including version control, code reproducibility, and deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage shifting priorities effectively.
  • Must be able to work core hours aligned with US Eastern Time (GMT-5).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global teams and articulate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Gurilândia e a Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Neste papel, você será responsável por promover o bem-estar emocional e psicológico dos alunos, apoiar o processo de aprendizagem, identificar e tratar questões emocionais ou comportamentais, e contribuir para a construção de um ambiente escolar inclusivo e saudável.

O que você fará:

  • Orientação a Pais e Educadores : Orientar pais, professores e outros membros da comunidade escolar sobre como lidar com questões comportamentais ou emocionais dos alunos. Oferecer estratégias de apoio para o desenvolvimento saudável das crianças e adolescentes;
  • Promoção de Saúde Mental : Desenvolver e implementar programas de prevenção e promoção da saúde mental, trabalhando na conscientização sobre questões como bullying, depressão, ansiedade, abuso de substâncias e outros temas relevantes;
  • Aconselhamento Escolar : Apoiar professores e gestores educacionais em questões relacionadas ao comportamento dos alunos, sugerindo intervenções pedagógicas ou adaptativas quando necessário;
  • Mediar Conflitos : Atuar na mediação de conflitos entre alunos, professores e/ou pais, buscando soluções para melhorar a convivência escolar e fortalecer o respeito mútuo;
  • Apoio a Projetos Educativos : Colaborar com a escola na implementação de projetos e atividades voltados para o desenvolvimento emocional e social dos alunos;
  • Acompanhamento de Casos Especiais : Trabalhar em parceria com outros profissionais (como assistentes sociais, psiquiatras e terapeutas) no acompanhamento de alunos com necessidades especiais ou transtornos mais graves;
  • Educação Socioemocional : Realizar atividades educativas sobre habilidades socioemocionais, como empatia, resolução de conflitos, habilidades de comunicação e autoestima.

DENTRO DO CONTEXTO DA DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA: Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em Psicologia;
  • Empatia e sensibilidade às necessidades dos alunos;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento infantil e adolescente, bem como das dinâmicas escolares.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Estamos buscando pessoas engenheiras de dados com background e expertise na área, criativas, com energia, comprometidas, que saiba trabalhar bem em equipe, com foco de resolver o problema do cliente com muita qualidade e que queiram encarar conosco o desafio de fazer parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo Crédito da Stone.

description:
Overview

Sobre a Allintra

A Allintra é uma startup brasileira de tecnologia com uma missão ambiciosa: transformar a forma como o trading de criptoativos é feito no Brasil. Estamos construindo uma plataforma de investimento de nível profissional, inteligente e colaborativa conectando traders experientes a investidores em um ecossistema seguro, transparente e poderoso. Estamos no momento mais decisivo da nossa jornada: o lançamento do Beta Test privado da plataforma. E para garantir que essa fase seja inesquecível para nossos primeiros 500 usuários, buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por experiência do cliente, tecnologia e construção de comunidade.

Sua missão

Você será a ponte entre nossos usuários e o time Allintra. Vai garantir que os traders se sintam ouvidos, valorizados e empoderados, transformando seus feedbacks em decisões estratégicas de produto. Durante o lançamento, será responsável por cultivar uma comunidade ativa, acompanhar a jornada dos primeiros usuários e traduzir suas experiências em insights acionáveis. Você irá atuar diretamente na construção da jornada dos usuários reais, desenvolvendo processos de engajamento, estruturando canais de escuta e ajudando a consolidar uma cultura de produto centrada no cliente. Mais do que suporte, buscamos o protagonista na criação de experiências que encantem, envolvem e gerem valor real.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na estruturação da experiência contínua dos usuários da plataforma, garantindo um atendimento encantador e proativo.
  • Ser o ponto focal de relacionamento com os usuários e clientes do Allintra, garantindo engajamento, acolhimento e suporte proativo.
  • Manter a escuta ativa da comunidade de usuários, identificando comportamentos, desafios e oportunidades de evolução de produto.
  • Acompanhar a jornada de uso e mapear pontos de atrito ou oportunidades de encantamento dos usuários.
  • Coletar feedbacks via formulários, entrevistas e 1:1s com usuários, transformando as percepções em relatórios estruturados e acionáveis para as áreas de Produto e Marketing.

Overview

Medical Writer - Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist
Location: Remote

Position Summary

The Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist is a professional responsible for the creation of regulatory materials for investigational and marketed products in alignment with regulatory and compliance practices. The individual will work directly with client teams to manage regulatory writing projects.

Essential Functions

  • Regulatory writing skills with mastery of 3 or more regulatory document types (eg, clinical study protocols, clinical study reports, briefing documents, IND, NDA, and MAA components).
  • Solid understanding of and ability to apply the statistical, regulatory, and medical communication concepts needed to independently write regulatory documents in more than 1 therapeutic area. Manages at least 3 single-document projects simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory guidance (eg, ICH, FDA, EMA) for clinical trial conduct, including document-specific guidance. Core cross-functional clinical research roles and procedures, and how they relate to document preparation. Acts as a primary writer and/or project manager for key documents and projects.
  • Ensures document accuracy, completeness, and consistency of messaging. Organizes and leads cross-functional document review meetings, clarifies and incorporates feedback, and works with cross-functional subject matter experts to resolve unclear comments and differences of opinion between functional areas.
  • Performs document-level QC (including abbreviations, references to sources, data in text versus data in tables, figures, or graphs) and writer peer review (logical flow, sense check, etc.).
  • Leads project-level management activities, i.e., timeline preparation and oversight and meeting scheduling. Participates in guiding less experienced writers on those documents for which they have expertise.
  • Proactively contributes to improvements to medical writing processes.
  • Understands, complies with, and contributes to the updates of SOPs, templates, best practices, policies, and regulatory writing style guides.
  • Develops project-level lexicons and conventions.

Position Qualifications

Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative. Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook, and quickly able to learn new software. Ability to apply regulatory guidelines to content development.

Skills and Abilities

Education: Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (e.g., life sciences, pharmacy, medicine) or relevant work experience; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience: More than 2 years (typically 3-5 years) of experience in scientific/medical/regulatory writing in the pharmaceutical domain.

Computer Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Work Environment

Remote - Europe

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.

  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and experience designing or maintaining microservices-based systems.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web and mobile technologies and techniques.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience with agile methodologies.
  • Advanced Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Skills.
  • Ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Competence in defining clear objectives and ensuring the team meets project milestones.

  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize technical work based on business value, system health, and long-term platform goals.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Active contribution to aligning technological strategies with broader organizational objectives.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating alignment and decision-making.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Product Managers, Product Owners, Squad Leaders, Designers, and other teams, tribes or squads in defining priorities and delivering value.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, guiding career development, and fostering a growth-oriented, high-performance team environment.
  • Capacity to make thoughtful, context-aware decisions that balance technical debt, delivery speed, and business impact.
  • Ability to recognize team dynamics, support team members through challenges, and cultivate psychological safety.
  • Proactive in owning outcomes, addressing blockers, and ensuring that the squad delivers on commitments.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, reprioritizing as needed, and adjusting to new business or technical demands.

  • Capable of influencing product and technical decisions at squad level and beyond, aligning technical initiatives with broader company goals.
  • Oriented toward retrospectives, feedback loops, and implementing process and culture improvements.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, with a bias for action and results-oriented problem solving.

  • Ability to make decisions based on accurate information, technical indicators, and impact metrics, using data to prioritize initiatives, guide trade-offs, and measure success.


Industry-Specific Knowledge

As a Tech Leader, you bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand the operational workflows, regulatory considerations, and business impact that shape these areas.

You leverage this knowledge not only to guide the technical implementation of backend solutions, such as payment orchestration, fraud-detection services, or onboarding flows, but also to collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders in defining priorities and making trade-offs that balance technical feasibility with strategic objectives.

Your role involves translating domain-specific requirements into actionable tasks, mentoring engineers to understand the business context behind their work, and ensuring the team delivers solutions that are robust, compliant, and aligned with customer needs. You help the squad connect technical work with revenue, performance, and user experience outcomes, creating an environment where engineers contribute with full awareness of business impact.

Overview

We hire for impact and value core principles: beyond excellence, extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and mission focus. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with these values, we want to hear from you.

You\'re building top real estate channels across the country, making clients locally famous, and setting a high bar for content. You\'ll own the strategy, the story, and the systems behind uploads that scale our clients\' local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. This role blends creativity with analytics across ideation, production planning, post-production oversight, and YouTube performance.

Your curiosity for real estate fundamentals matches your passion for dominating YouTube\'s local market. You\'re excited to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market leadership. You\'ll lead production, posting, and packaging directions, distill insights into engaging content, and drive continuous improvement through analysis and feedback while maintaining alignment with business initiatives. You\'ll collaborate with our YouTube Strategists/Client Success Manager, creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

Location: Remote (work from home). Hours: Mon – Fri 9am – 6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed. Compensation and benefits reflect experience and progression from part-time to full-time roles.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure

  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre-production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre- and post-production workflows; identify opportunities to prototype AI-driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, Shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion

YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture

  • Support YouTube channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and other experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates while reinforcing the authority, credibility, and mission of our clients; maintain each brand\'s distinct tone and consistency
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run consistent A/B testing for packaging on back catalogue
  • Keep relevant YouTube scorecard metrics and present weekly insights to team and clients

Pre-Production

  • Support ideation and outlier research sessions
  • Provide feedback and insight on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four-to-six-week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts and title options)

Post-Production

  • Ownership and management of post-production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve audience engagement
  • Work with Senior Editor to provide retention notes and final approval for uploads
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post-production

Results

  • Support 45-60+ videos monthly within your team; you\'ll primarily manage around 5-10 clients
  • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and 7.5–10M+ in annual sales per client)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform channel baselines in impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber-to-view ratios; higher average views per video and faster velocity in 24/48 hours
  • Document content experiments and A/B tests; increase AI/tool usage to boost team leverage
  • Improved client sentiment on brand and growth through performance discussions

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape — concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development (bonus for large educational channels)
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., frame.io)
  • Proficiency with Notion and GSuite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • Slack is the go-to for communications
  • Value over-communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings, Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader, and Weekly meetings with the creative team

Compensation

Salary range is $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually, with progression from part-time to full-time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000 – $36,000 USD a year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part-time to full-time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance-based advancement opportunities

How to Apply

To apply, please submit: a PDF resume named according to your name, links to YouTube channels and growth metrics, a completed personality quiz URL, and responses to the following questions:

  1. What\'s the most innovative YouTube strategy you\'ve implemented and what were the results?
  2. What does the quote "Work is love made visible" by Khalil Gibran mean to you personally?
  3. Link to your submission materials: (email)

Submissions should go to the email address above. I\'m happy to answer any questions you may have about the application process. Thank you for your consideration.

title: Homebuying Specialist
description:
Overview

Are you competitive, persuasive, and ready to thrive in a remote sales role that rewards hustle and drive? Neighbors Bank, a leading innovator in the mortgage industry, is looking for ambitious sales professionals who know how to make connections, earn trust quickly, and drive conversations forward.

We\'re not looking for mortgage experts. We\'re looking for self-starters with a proven track record in sales — people who can sell over the phone, adapt quickly, and bring energy to every conversation. If you\'ve excelled in a high-volume sales role or competitive environment, you might be exactly who we need.

Our thriving remote culture isn\'t just a perk — it\'s a reflection of how we see the future of work. We want to empower incredible people to do a great job wherever they are, while enabling flexibility .

As a Homebuying Specialist, you\'ll be the voice that turns interest into action. You\'ll be the first point of contact for clients actively pursuing homeownership, allowing you to focus on what you do best — connecting with people and closing deals — without ever making a single cold call. You\'ll play a vital role in fulfilling our vision of making the dream of homeownership more affordable, accessible, and achievable.

What Makes This Role Exciting?

  • Remote-First with Flexibility: Flourish in a fully remote role with the freedom to structure your day, focus on performance, and rely on tools that support long-term success.
  • Big Rewards for Top Performers: Competitive, uncapped commissions and bonuses await those who excel. Top performers are earning over $50 per hour.
  • Be Part of Something Bigger: Join a fast-growing team with an award-winning culture that\'s been recognized as a Top Workplace in the Financial Services industry while making homeownership achievable for thousands of underserved families.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Including health and dental coverage, a wellness program, 401(k) matching, PTO, paid holidays, and more.
  • Problem Solvers Wanted: This role is ideal for individuals who tackle challenges and find innovative solutions.

Your Journey at Neighbors Bank

Most Homebuying Specialists earn $65,000-$80,000 annually, with top performers exceeding that range. We provide a comprehensive program to support you in reaching your income goals in remote sales and mortgage origination.

From day one, you\'ll earn a base pay of $20 per hour, plus uncapped performance-based bonuses . While this is a full-time role, your earnings potential is based on your production — not your schedule.

You\'ll also benefit from:

  • A structured onboarding program to help you master the loan origination process.
  • Real-time coaching and support from experienced team leads.
  • The flexibility to build a schedule that works for you.

This is a full-time position where you can expect to work up to 40 hours each week, but we are seeking individuals who can work at least 64 hours each month during the evenings and weekends (or roughly 16 hours per week after 5pm or any time Saturday and Sunday). You will have a high degree of flexibility with when you choose to work each week. Top performers maximize their earnings by leaning into evenings, weekends, and other high-conversion windows.

Our People and Culture

Our People and Culture are our greatest strengths. We\'re seeking individuals who:

  • Are passionate about their job and have fun doing it.
  • Will deliver results with integrity.
  • Enjoy finding ways to enhance the lives of others every day.

Your Role as a Homebuying Specialist

Homebuying Specialists are the first voice our customers hear, and a critical part of turning curiosity into confidence. Our clients seek support from Neighbors Bank, so there is no cold calling required. Your role is to connect quickly, ask the right questions, and guide potential borrowers through the first steps of the home loan process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build rapport and collect borrower financial and credit information.
  • Educate borrowers on the loan process and identify financing options.
  • Analyze credit, income, and assets to prequalify or deny applications.
  • Provide clear communication with borrowers while guiding them through initial documentation and next steps.
  • Secure documentation and ensure all stages of the loan process are completed efficiently.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Are You the One?

No mortgage experience? No problem — but sales talent, grit, and hustle are a must. We\'re looking for high-performing individuals with a proven ability to connect with people, work independently, and close the deal. Whether you come from a call center, cold-calling environment, or another competitive sales background, success in this role comes down to mindset and motivation.

This role rewards self-starters who can adapt quickly, think on their feet, and bring energy to every conversation. If that sounds like you, read on.

Here\'s what makes a great fit

  • Thrive working remotely and staying self-motivated.
  • Have succeeded in fast-paced or performance-based roles.
  • Bring a strong competitive drive and hunger to earn.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers.
  • Stay focused under pressure and in high-volume settings.
  • College degrees are not required, but the ability to learn quickly is essential.

This isn\'t the role for you if

  • You need frequent oversight to stay on track.
  • You prefer routine tasks over rapid change.
  • You're not comfortable and confident talking to customers on the phone.

Where We\'re Hiring

We\'re actively hiring in the following states: AL, AZ, AR, FL, ID, IA, KS, MS, MO, MT, OK, TX, UT, and VA.

Why Neighbors Bank?

Neighbors Bank is more than just a workplace — it\'s a community. Our mission is to Enhance Lives , and we\'re passionate about doing that through innovative solutions and a culture of collaboration and excellence. If you\'re ready to join a team where your contributions truly matter, we\'d love to hear from you!

The People and the Culture are Neighbors Bank\'s greatest strengths. We seek individuals who are passionate about their job, deliver results with integrity, and enjoy enhancing the lives of others every day.

Neighbors Bank\'s recognition as being a Top Workplace in Financial Services: Top Workplaces.

Neighbors Bank is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected classifications.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

Caso você participe de um processo seletivo afirmativo para Pessoa com Deficiência no Jusbrasil, nossa equipe de Talent Acquisition solicitará a apresentação do seu laudo médico ou do Certificado de Reabilitação Profissional emitido pelo INSS. Ao fornecer essas informações, você declara que elas são verdadeiras e compreende que, em casos de incompatibilidade entre o laudo apresentado e os requisitos legais da vaga afirmativa, isso poderá ser considerado no processo de avaliação e eventual não preenchimento da posição.”
